item.title: How do Parties vote in the Austrian National Council?
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: The latest release of the {ParlAT} package introduces the ability to extract parties’ votes on items discussed in the third reading of the Austrian National Council. This post introduces the new feature by presenting some exemplary queries on the voting from the 20th to the current 28th legislative period.

item.title: 28th Austrian National Council: Prior Experiences as MPs.
item.dc:creator: Roland Schmidt
item.description: Who speaks for how long in the National Council of Austria’s Parliament? And who respects the relevant time limits?
